faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need a card to start?
faq.a1: No. Every plan except Enterprise can start with a {{days}}-day free trial of the plan you pick, with {{documents}} documents. The trial is optional: with it nothing is charged, and it never turns into a paid plan by itself. Or you can pay with your application instead.
faq.a2: You choose when you sign up: start the free trial, or pay with your application by bank transfer, uploading the receipt, or in cash. The Fawtir team checks your company and Peppol participant details, and your paid subscription starts only after your company is approved and your payment is confirmed.
faq.a3: Every document your company issues: invoices, including simplified invoices from the point of sale, credit notes, debit notes and self-billed invoices. A document still counts if you cancel it later, and sending it again is free. Supplier invoices, credit notes and debit notes you receive count too, once each when they arrive, unless your plan does not count received documents. Drafts are not counted.
faq.q4: What happens when I pass my allowance?
faq.a4: We email you when you reach {{thresholds}} percent of the allowance. When none is left, you cannot issue documents, and supplier invoices you receive are held: you see that they are waiting, but cannot open them until you buy extra documents. Extra documents are bought ahead: by card they are added at once, by bank transfer or cash once Fawtir confirms the payment. They are used after your plan's own documents and end with your subscription month, with no carry-over and no refund. Your allowance resets each month on your subscription date. To move to a bigger plan, contact the Fawtir team and they will change it for you.
faq.q5: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.a5: You can cancel any time, and your plan runs to the end of the period you paid for. To change your plan, contact the Fawtir team; a smaller plan starts from your next renewal. There are no setup fees and no minimum term. If a renewal is not paid, you keep {{grace}} days of grace before the account goes read-only, and your records stay readable and exportable for the 10 years the law requires.
faq.a6: No. Point of sale and thermal receipts are on every plan with no terminal charge. A POS receipt counts as one document against your allowance.
faq.a7: No. Prices are shown exclusive of {{rate}}% VAT, which is added to your subscription bill.
faq.a7NoVat: No VAT is added to Fawtir subscriptions, so the price shown is the amount on your subscription bill.
faq.a8: Enterprise is Business Plus with limits agreed on a call: documents, people, branches and price are set for your contract, automatic ERP extraction is included, and an account manager looks after you. Talk to our team and we will put a proposal together.
faq.q9: Which plan can connect my ERP?
faq.a9: Business Plus. It carries the REST API, webhooks and ERP field mapping, so your own system can send and receive documents through Fawtir. Automatic ERP extraction, where Fawtir reads the documents out of your ERP for you, is a priced add-on on Business Plus and included on Enterprise.
faq.a1Varies: No. With a free trial nothing is charged: it starts when your account is approved and never turns into a paid plan by itself. If you pay with your application instead, your paid subscription starts only after your company is approved and your payment is confirmed.

The report was refused the same day under {{code}} because the tax category on one line disagreed with the rate applied. It has not been corrected or resubmitted, so {{vat}} of VAT sits outside the figure above and the sale is undeclared as at the date of this report.

builtReport.attestationBody: Fawtir has prepared this report from its own records of what was sent over Peppol to the Oman Tax Authority's Fawtara endpoint and of the MLS messages that came back. Every entry is supported by a stored Tax Data Document and, where acknowledged, by the MLS message that answered it. These records cannot be edited and each file carries a fingerprint taken at the moment it was stored.
builtReport.attestationLimits: What this report does not do. It states what was reported, not whether the underlying invoices are correct. Fawtir does not audit the amounts, the tax treatment or the trade behind them. Figures here should agree with the Tax Authority's own records, which can be checked invoice by invoice using the TDD UUIDs.

stage.tenYearsTitle: Records are destroyed, invoice by invoice

reactivate.body: {{name}} can sign in again with their existing username and password and their usual second factor. They come back with no platform role: give them one afterwards if they need it. They are told by email.

reason.label: Reason

mfaReset.title: Reset two-step sign-in for {{name}}?
mfaReset.bodyApp: This removes {{name}}’s authenticator app and recovery codes and signs them out everywhere. They sign in again with a code sent to their email. They are told by email.
mfaReset.bodyNoApp: {{name}} has no authenticator app set up, so there is nothing to remove: this only signs them out everywhere. They sign in again with a code sent to their email. They are told by email.

mfaReset.done_other: {{name}}’s two-step sign-in was reset and {{count}} sessions were ended.
mfaReset.doneNoSessions: {{name}}’s two-step sign-in was reset. They had no open sessions.

error.refused: Fawtir refused this reset. You can’t reset your own two-step sign-in, and you may no longer have access.

emailChange.title: Change {{name}}’s sign-in email
emailChange.body: Nothing changes yet. A confirmation code goes to the new address, and {{name}}’s sign-in email moves only once they enter it, signed in to their own account, within 24 hours. Their current address is told.
emailChange.bodySelf: Nothing changes yet. A confirmation code goes to the new address, and your sign-in email moves once you enter it from “Confirm new sign-in email” in your menu, within 24 hours. Your current address is told.
emailChange.pending: A confirmation code was sent to {{newEmail}}. {{name}}’s sign-in email changes once they confirm it from their own account, by {{expires}}. Until then it stays {{currentEmail}}, which has been told.
emailChange.pendingSelf: A confirmation code was sent to {{newEmail}}. Enter it from “Confirm new sign-in email” in your menu by {{expires}}. Until then you sign in with {{currentEmail}}.

error.same: That is already their sign-in email.
error.conflict: Fawtir refused this change: the new address may already belong to another operator, or this person’s email changed since the page loaded. Reload the page and check.
error.rejected: Fawtir did not accept these details. Check the new address and the reason.
error.refused: Fawtir refused this change. You may no longer have access.

lifecycle.lockBody: {{name}} is signed out everywhere straight away and can’t sign in until an administrator unlocks them. Their roles and details stay as they are.
lifecycle.lockDone: {{name}} is locked and was signed out everywhere.
lifecycle.unlockBody: {{name}} can sign in again with their usual details and second factor. A lockout after wrong passwords is lifted too.
lifecycle.deactivateBody: {{name}} is signed out everywhere straight away and can no longer sign in. If they are reactivated later, they come back with no platform role.
lifecycle.deactivateDone: {{name}} was deactivated and signed out everywhere. They are now under Deactivated operators.

lifecycle.note: The trial every new tenant starts on, and what happens at renewal, on a failed payment, at cancellation and on a change of plan.

payments.note: How a subscription invoice is paid and when the account is activated. Every online payment goes through Paymob; the other methods are settled by an operator.

fixed.note: Four positions the platform takes that no setting can change.

position.retention: 10 years; 15 where the records relate to real estate.
position.complianceRecord: Always, including while the account is suspended.

position.livePlanChange: Applies to new subscriptions only. Tenants on the old terms keep them.

fixed.why: These are legal obligations, not choices. A setting would let a plan be sold that cannot meet the mandate, so they are listed here, and nowhere else.

activate.title: Activate this version?

erpEntitlement.title: ERP integration
erpEntitlement.enabledBody: This tenant can set up and run ERP connections, Bridge Upload and API Push. Disabling stops new ERP work; their connections, mappings, documents and reports are kept, and reading them stays available.
erpEntitlement.disabledBody: This tenant cannot create ERP connections, upload or push documents, or recover them. Enabling takes effect at once, and any collection schedules they had resume.
erpEntitlement.grantTitle: Enable ERP integration for this tenant?

erpEntitlement.revokeTitle: Disable ERP integration for this tenant?
erpEntitlement.revokeBody: Scheduled collection stops after the page in hand, and uploads, pushes, recoveries and ERP key creation are refused. Nothing is deleted: connections, mappings, documents and reports stay, and enabling again resumes collection. The change and your reason are recorded in the audit log.

tenant.routesNote: Read from the company's mapping. A route that is not certified is not collected.

readiness.draft: {{count}} fields mapped from the template, edited on {{date}}, not yet certified. Nothing is collected until it is.
readiness.ready: Template applied, nothing edited. Run the certification and the connection can start collecting.
readiness.certified: Certified: every invoice this connection collects goes through this mapping.
readiness.stale: The mapping changed since it was certified. Certify again before collecting.
readiness.unmapped: No template for this system yet. Map the fields by hand in the wizard, then certify.

reset.title: Reset to the template?
reset.body: Your edits are replaced by the {{template}} template ({{count}} fields). Certification is lost, so certify again before collecting.
reset.done: Reset to template. Certify again before collecting.

discovery.title: What the template covers
discovery.note_one: Fields discovered on {{date}} from {{count}} sample invoice.
discovery.note_other: Fields discovered on {{date}} from {{count}} sample invoices.

writeBackTab.title: Write-back
writeBackTab.note: After Fawtir hears back from the Tax Authority, the outcome is written into the ERP record.
writeBackTab.needsWrite: Needs the Write scope. Change it in Settings.

uuid.label: UUID
uuid.body: The document's identifier at the Tax Authority

submittedAt.label: Submitted at
submittedAt.body: When it reached the Tax Authority

rejectionReason.label: Rejection reason
rejectionReason.body: The rule that failed, when one did

qr.label: QR
qr.body: The code the printed invoice must carry

outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.note: Every write-back queued for this connection. The connector gives up after {{max}} attempts.
outbox.emptyOff: Write-back is off. Nothing is queued.

form.title: Connection
form.note: The name, the address and how often the connector runs.
form.label: Label
form.urlHint: The ERP's base address. It must use https.
form.urlHttps: The address must start with https://
form.scheduleHint: How often invoices are collected. A change takes effect from the next run.
form.scopesHint: Read is always on. Write lets the connector write the outcome back.
form.writeBackHint: Write the Fawtir outcome into each ERP record.
form.saveNote: Every change is written to the activity log.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.note: The secret is never shown, only what it signs in as and whether it still works.
credentials.rotated: Credentials replaced and tested in {{latency}} ms. The connection is back.
credentials.rotationFailed: The new credentials were refused: {{reason}} The old ones are gone; enter working ones.

replace.title: Replace credentials
replace.subtitle: The old secret is destroyed when you save; the new one is tested at once.
replace.note: Fawtir keeps the login and the key's last four characters, never the secret.

unsupported.REVISIONS: Draft revision history is not stored yet. Mapping revisions are under History.
unsupported.SAMPLES: Samples are not saved yet. One chosen here is used for this visit only.
unsupported.ACTIVITY_LOG: Mapping changes are recorded, but there is no screen to read them yet.
unsupported.VALUE_MAPS: Code-to-code tables are not supported yet. Use a transform instead.
unsupported.ERP_VERSION: Fawtir records the ERP, not its version.
unsupported.PROFILE_ORIGIN: Whether the live expression came from the wizard is inferred, not recorded.

stateHelp.GLOBALLY_DISABLED: Scheduled collection is switched off for the whole platform. This connection keeps its own settings.
stateHelp.NOT_CONFIGURED: Add the extraction settings below before anything can run.
stateHelp.CONNECTION_NOT_READY: Mark the connection ready on the Settings tab first.
stateHelp.DISABLED_BY_OPERATOR: Someone switched production collection off for this connection.
stateHelp.MAPPING_NOT_CERTIFIED: Collection would fetch invoices and reject every one. Certify the mapping first.
stateHelp.RUNNING: A collection cycle is in progress.
stateHelp.BACKOFF: A run failed, so the next attempt is being held back.
stateHelp.FAILED_LAST_RUN: The most recent run failed, and the schedule carries no penalty.
stateHelp.WAITING: Nothing to do. The next run is scheduled.
stateHelp.NOT_CONFIGURED_ISSUE_TIME: Collection is paused until the invoice issue time pointer is set. Nothing has failed.

cursorKind.derivedHint: Reads the next position from each document
cursorKind.opaqueHint: Reads the next position from the response envelope

status.title: Collection status
status.description: Read from the server. Fawtir decides this, not this screen.

config.title: Configure extraction
config.description: Where the invoices are in the ERP response, and how to page through them.
config.readOnly: You do not have permission to change these settings.
config.none: Extraction is not configured for this connection.

field.intervalHint: ISO-8601, for example PT30M. Leave empty for the platform default. Effective: {{effective}}
field.transactionTypeHint: 20-character BTOM-001 bitmap. The mapping certification is scoped to this value.
field.cursorParameterHint: The query parameter the cursor is sent in. Required unless you chose Page token.
field.documentCursorPointerHint: Where each document carries its ordering value.
field.nextCursorPointerHint: Where the response carries the token for the next page.
field.pageSizeParameterHint: The query parameter the page size is sent in. The size itself is a platform setting.
field.initialCursorHint: Optional. Where a first collection begins, and what a sample fetch reads from.
field.documentIssueTimePointerHint: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to each invoice's issue time, for example /invoice/issueTime. The value there must be a time (HH:mm:ss) or a date and time with an offset.
field.documentIdPointerHint: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to each document's own id, for example /id

sample.title: Fetch a sample invoice
sample.description: Asks Fawtir to collect one document, exactly as production would. Nothing is recorded and no invoice is created.
sample.noPermission: You do not have permission to fetch a sample.

handover.ready: Adds this document to the mapping samples for this visit and opens the preview. Nothing is stored.
handover.notJson: The mapping preview needs a JSON document, and this one is not JSON.
handover.atLimit: The mapping samples for this visit are full ({{limit}}). Remove one on the Samples screen first.

enablement.title: Production collection
enablement.description: Turning this on lets Fawtir collect from this ERP on its own, at the cadence above.
enablement.needCertified: Mapping certified for this transaction type
enablement.enabledNote: Collection is on. It still only runs while platform automation is on.
enablement.disabledNote: Collection is off. Nothing runs automatically.

issueTime.missing: The invoice issue time pointer is required before production collection can be enabled. Set it in the extraction settings below.
issueTime.missingReadOnly: The invoice issue time pointer is required before production collection can be enabled. Ask someone who can manage this connection to set it.

modeUnsupported.title: Nothing to collect here
modeUnsupported.body: Extraction settings apply only to connections Fawtir collects from. This connection receives invoices another way, so there is nothing to configure here.

bridge.title: Upload from your ERP
bridge.subtitle: Send one document exactly as your ERP produced it. Your ERP mapping turns it into an invoice, and the same document is never invoiced twice.

channels.title: How documents reach Fawtir
channels.managedPullBody: Fawtir collects documents from a connected ERP on its own.
channels.bridgeBody: You send one document yourself. No connection is needed.
channels.apiPushBody: Your ERP sends documents to Fawtir itself, with an ERP ingestion API key your developers set up.

readiness.title: Is your mapping ready?
readiness.readyBody: Your {{format}} mapping is certified for invoices, so uploads can become invoices.
readiness.notReadyBody: Your {{format}} mapping is not certified for invoices yet. An upload now is recorded and refused, and can be sent again unchanged once the mapping is certified.
readiness.note: Certified means the mapping produces a valid test invoice. Each real invoice is still checked on its own, so one can be refused even when the mapping is ready.
readiness.administratorOnly: Your administrator manages the ERP mapping. If an upload is refused because the mapping is not ready, ask them to certify it.
readiness.notReadyXmlBody: Fawtir has no certified XML mapping for invoices yet. An XML mapping is an XSLT stylesheet that is saved and certified through the Fawtir API, not on the mapping screens here. Until one is certified, an XML upload is recorded and refused.

document.title: Document
document.formatHint: The format your ERP produced the document in. Each format has its own mapping. An XML mapping is set up and certified through the Fawtir API.
document.drop: Drop a {{format}} file here, or click to choose one

problem.notJson: The file is not valid JSON.
problem.notObject: The file must hold one JSON object, the document itself.
problem.notXml: The file does not look like XML.
problem.size: The file is larger than 4 MB.
problem.tooLarge: This document is too large to send in one upload (4 MB).

identity.title: Your ERP's reference
identity.documentIdHint: Your ERP's own identifier for this document. Uploading the same ID and content again does not create a second invoice.
identity.versionHint: Optional. Use a new version to send a corrected document under the same ID.

result.acceptedBody: Your mapping produced the invoice and it has entered the invoicing pipeline. Delivery and the tax report follow on their own.
result.duplicateBody: This document was uploaded before and already produced its invoice. Nothing new was submitted.
result.follow: Follow it in the compliance activity

refusal.validation: The invoice was refused by validation. Nothing was submitted. The checks that failed:
refusal.mapping: Your mapping could not turn this document into an invoice. Nothing was submitted.
refusal.notSupported: This upload cannot be accepted right now. The most common reason is a mapping that is not yet certified for invoices. Nothing was submitted.
refusal.identityConflict: A different document was already uploaded under this ID and version. Send a corrected document under a new version.
refusal.inProgress: This document is already being processed. Try again in a moment; sending it again is safe.
refusal.alreadyRefused: This exact document was refused before and is not checked again. Send a corrected document under a new version.
refusal.duplicateInvoice: The invoice in this document already exists in Fawtir. Nothing was submitted.
refusal.idempotency: This upload clashed with an earlier one. Start again and upload once more.
refusal.notOperational: Your company is not yet set up to issue invoices.
refusal.emissionBlocked: Invoicing is paused for a short while on Fawtir's side. Try again later.
refusal.tooLarge: This document is too large to send in one upload (4 MB).
refusal.notJsonBody: The upload could not be sent in the expected form. Start again.
refusal.unreachable: Fawtir could not be reached. Check your connection and upload again; the same upload is recognised and is not invoiced twice.
refusal.numberReserved: This invoice number is reserved for a controlled test transmission on Fawtir's side for now. Nothing was submitted. Upload it again later.

reporting.pastTheEnd: There is nothing on this page for these filters.

window.label: Received between

problem.order: The start date must not be after the end date.
problem.tooLong: Choose at most 367 days. Narrow the dates to see older documents.

window.fixToRead: Fix the dates above to see the documents.

documents.title: Source documents
documents.subtitle: Every document your ERP sent to Fawtir, from every channel, and what became of it.
documents.caption: Source documents
documents.emptyFiltered: No documents match these filters in this period.
documents.emptyWindow: No documents were received in this period.

summary.title: This period
summary.note: Counted by the server over the dates, channel and connection chosen. The other filters narrow the list only.
summary.downstreamTitle: Where the accepted invoices stand now
summary.downstreamNote: Delivery failed counts invoices on the Peppol network only. Invoices for buyers outside the network are counted separately and are not failures.
summary.events: Also recorded: at least {{replays}} resends of documents already settled and at least {{conflicts}} refused conflicts. These come from the audit trail, which can miss an event and has none for managed pull.

displayExplain.REJECTED: The document was refused and did not become an invoice.
displayExplain.DUPLICATE: This document had already been received, so it did not become a second invoice.
displayExplain.WAITING_FOR_MAPPING: The document is waiting for your ERP mapping to exist or be certified.
displayExplain.RETRYABLE_FAILURE: The last attempt failed for a reason that may pass; the document can still be accepted.
displayExplain.SUBMITTED: The invoice exists and the transport has not acknowledged it yet.
displayExplain.SENT: The transport acknowledged the invoice; the recipient's side has not answered yet.
displayExplain.DELIVERED_UNCONFIRMED: The recipient's side answered without confirming, or did not answer in time.
displayExplain.OFF_NETWORK: The buyer is not on the Peppol network, so the invoice was not sent over it. Whether the buyer received it by other means is not recorded here.
displayExplain.DELIVERY_FAILED: The network leg ended without the invoice reaching the recipient, or they refused it.

reason.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Your ERP could not be reached
reason.SOURCE_TIMEOUT: Your ERP did not answer in time
reason.SOURCE_AUTHENTICATION_REJECTED: Your ERP refused the sign-in details
reason.SOURCE_PAYLOAD_UNREADABLE: The document could not be read in its format
reason.MAPPING_PROFILE_ABSENT: No ERP mapping is set up
reason.MAPPING_FAILED: The mapping could not produce an invoice
reason.SOURCE_IDENTITY_INVALID: The document's identifier or version is missing, blank or too long
reason.SOURCE_CONTENT_CHANGED: Your ERP sent different content under the same version
reason.SOURCE_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Your ERP sent a document larger than the 4 MiB limit
reason.OUTBOUND_WINDOW_INVOICE_RESERVED: The invoice number was reserved for a controlled test transmission

labelExplain.RECOVERY_PENDING: The document is held by an attempt nobody is working on. Fawtir's recovery will release it.
labelExplain.WAITING_FOR_MAPPING: The document is waiting for your ERP mapping to exist or be certified.
labelExplain.RETRYABLE_FAILURE: The last attempt failed for a reason that may pass.
labelExplain.ACCEPTED_WITHOUT_INVOICE: The document was accepted but no invoice exists for it. This should not happen; it is reported, not repaired.
labelExplain.TRANSPORT_PENDING: The invoice has waited longer than expected for the transport to acknowledge it.
labelExplain.RESPONSE_PENDING: The transport acknowledged the invoice and the recipient's side has not answered for too long.
labelExplain.DELIVERY_FAILED: The network leg ended without the invoice reaching the recipient, or they refused it.
labelExplain.TAX_REPORT_ATTENTION: The tax report could not be produced, was refused as a message, was given up on, or is waiting past its deadline. This is separate from delivery.
labelExplain.ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: Automatic attempts ran out without an answer about the document itself. Recover it from its page (managed pull), or send it again as a new version.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.note: What the ledgers and the audit trail recorded, with the time each was recorded. Audit events are evidence and can be incomplete; managed pull records none, except a person's recovery.
timeline.truncated: Older audit events exist and are not shown. Only the newest {{count}} are read.
timeline.empty: Nothing has been recorded for this document yet.

detail.title: Source document
detail.subtitle: One document from your ERP, and each step it went through.
detail.overallNote: A one-word summary of the furthest point reached. The sections below are what the ledgers record.
detail.retryableYes: Yes, if the same document is tried again
detail.acceptedNoInvoice: The document was accepted but no invoice is recorded for it.
detail.noInvoice: No invoice was created from this document.
detail.offNetworkNote: This invoice was not sent over the Peppol network. The ledger state below describes a network leg the invoice does not have and says nothing about whether the buyer received it.
detail.responseNote: Separate from delivery: an invoice the transport acknowledged can still be refused here.
detail.responseNotApplicable: Not applicable: the invoice did not travel the Peppol network.
detail.responseNone: Nothing has been recorded yet. This is not a refusal.
detail.taxNote: Separate from delivery. A refused report is a refusal of the report as a message, not a tax verdict.
detail.taxNone: No tax report obligation has been recorded yet.

findings.title: Validation findings
findings.truncated: Only the first {{count}} findings were kept.
findings.none: No findings were kept for this document.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.subtitle: Documents that have not reached where they should have, worked out by the server when you open this page. Nothing here is stored or needs to be dismissed.
attention.responsePendingUnevaluated: No approved waiting time for the recipient's answer is set, so a missing answer is not reported as late.
attention.emptyFiltered: No documents carry this label in this period.
attention.empty: Nothing needs attention in this period.

runs.title: Extraction runs
runs.subtitle: Each time documents were collected or sent from your ERP, newest first.
runs.countersNote: The counters are what each run recorded when it ran. They do not change afterwards.

run.title: Extraction run
run.subtitle: What the run recorded, and where its documents stand now.
run.documentsNote: The documents this run holds now. A document taken over by a later run is listed there.

operatorRecovery.SOURCE_TARGET_MISSING: document not in the ERP's answer
operatorRecovery.SOURCE_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE: the ERP could not repeat the request
operatorRecovery.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: the ERP could not be reached
operatorRecovery.SOURCE_AUTHENTICATION_REJECTED: the ERP refused the sign-in details
operatorRecovery.PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE: stored sign-in details could not be opened

recover.title: Recovery
recover.note: Offered because this document ran out of automatic attempts.
recover.explain: Fawtir stopped collecting this document after its automatic attempts ran out, and collection has since moved on. A recovery asks the ERP for it once more with the original request.
recover.noPermission: Only someone allowed to recover documents can do this. Ask an administrator.
recover.confirmRefetch: ask the ERP again for the page that originally contained this document;
recover.confirmOnlyThis: consider only this document, so no other document on that page is processed again;
recover.confirmCheckpoint: leave the connection's collection position where it is, so collection carries on unchanged;
recover.confirmSameContent: process the document only if the ERP returns exactly the same content as before.
recover.mayRetry: You can try the recovery again.

succeeded.title: Recovery completed successfully.
succeeded.body: The document was accepted and an invoice was created for it. Delivery and tax reporting follow as for any other invoice.

succeededNoInvoice.title: Recovery completed successfully.
succeededNoInvoice.body: The document was accepted. The page below shows its current state.

alreadyRecovered.title: This document has already been recovered.
alreadyRecovered.body: Nothing was fetched or submitted again. The page below shows its current state.

processingRetryable.title: The document was fetched again, but no invoice was produced this time.
processingRetryable.body: The ERP returned the same document, but Fawtir could not finish processing it, for a reason that may pass.

processingRefused.title: The document was fetched again and refused.
processingRefused.body: The ERP returned the same document, but it was refused: {{reason}}. It cannot be recovered. Correct it in the ERP and send it as a new version.

contextUnavailable.title: Automatic recovery is not available for this record.
contextUnavailable.body: This document was processed before recovery information was captured. Correct or reissue it in the ERP and send it as a new version, or upload it instead.

replayUnavailable.title: The ERP can no longer repeat the original request.
replayUnavailable.body: The page the ERP originally returned may have expired, or the connection now reads it differently. Automatic recovery is not available for this record. Send the document again from the ERP as a new version, or upload it instead.

targetMissing.title: The document was not in the ERP's answer.
targetMissing.body: The ERP answered the original request, but this document was no longer in it. Nothing was processed. Check the document in the ERP and send it again as a new version, or upload it instead.

sourceChanged.title: The ERP now returns different content for this document.
sourceChanged.body: Fawtir did not process the changed document automatically. If the change is intended, send it from the ERP as a new version so it goes through the normal integration flow. Otherwise, check the document in the ERP or contact support.

notEligible.title: This document can no longer be recovered.
notEligible.body: Its state has changed since the page was opened. The page below shows its current state.

inProgress.title: A recovery of this document is already running.
inProgress.body: Wait a moment; the page below shows its current state.

channelUnsupported.title: Only managed pull documents can be recovered.
channelUnsupported.body: Send this document again from its source instead.

connectionUnusable.title: The connection is not ready to collect.
connectionUnusable.body: The connection this document came from may be paused, archived or missing its sign-in details. Fix the connection first.

sourceAuthRejected.title: The ERP refused the connection's sign-in details.
sourceAuthRejected.body: Replace the sign-in details on the connection first.

sourceUnavailable.title: The ERP could not be reached.

erpNotEnabled.title: ERP integration is not enabled for your organisation.
erpNotEnabled.body: Documents cannot be recovered until it is enabled again.

forbidden.title: You don't have permission to recover documents.

notFound.title: This document was not found.
notFound.body: It may belong to another organisation, or the link is wrong.

rateLimited.title: Too many recovery requests in a short time.
rateLimited.body: Wait a minute before trying again.

unreachable.title: Fawtir could not be reached.
unreachable.body: Check your connection. The recovery may or may not have run; reload the page to see the document's current state.

other.title: The recovery could not be completed.
other.body: Contact support if this keeps happening.

platformUnavailable.title: Fawtir could not open the connection's stored sign-in details.
platformUnavailable.body: Nothing was fetched or processed. This is on Fawtir's side; try again later, and contact support if it continues.

subscriptionNotStarted.title: Your subscription hasn't started yet.
subscriptionNotStarted.body: Documents can be recovered once it starts, when your company is approved and your payment is confirmed.

subscriptionSuspended.title: Your subscription is suspended.
subscriptionSuspended.body: Pay the open bill in Settings, under Bills and payment, to recover documents again.

subscriptionCancelled.title: Your subscription has ended.
subscriptionCancelled.body: Choose a plan in Settings, under Plan and usage, to recover documents again.

apiPush.title: API push
apiPush.subtitle: Your ERP sends each document to Fawtir's API with one of these keys. Your mapping turns it into an invoice.

create.title: Create an ERP ingestion key
create.subtitle: The key can submit documents only. It cannot read data or change settings.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Say which system uses it, for example "Odoo production".
create.documentsRequired: Choose at least one kind of document.
create.expiryHint: Leave empty and the key expires in {{defaultDays}} days. It can last at most {{maxDays}} days. Keys for ERP push always expire.

keys.title: ERP ingestion keys
keys.note: Last used is updated about once a minute, so recent use can take a minute or two to show.
keys.empty: No ERP ingestion keys yet. Create one for each system that sends documents.

confirm.rotateBody: A new key is created and shown once. The current key keeps working for a short grace period so you can update your ERP, then it stops.
confirm.completeBody: This old key stops working now instead of at {{when}}. Do this once every system uses the new key.
confirm.revokeBody: The key stops working immediately and cannot be restored. Turning ERP off and on again does not bring it back. Create a new key if you need one.

refusal.erpNotEnabled: ERP is not enabled for your organisation, so ERP ingestion keys cannot be created or rotated. Ask Fawtir to enable ERP.
refusal.noApiAccess: Your plan does not include API access, so API keys cannot be created or rotated. Move to a plan that includes it.
refusal.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage API keys.
refusal.conflict: This key was already rotated or revoked. The list now shows its current state.
refusal.notFound: This key no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
refusal.invalid: Fawtir could not accept these details. Check the expiry date and try again.
refusal.unreachable: Fawtir could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

secret.title: Your new key
secret.once: Copy this key now. It is shown only once and cannot be shown again. If you lose it, rotate the key to get a new one.
secret.copyFailed: Copy did not work. Select the key and copy it by hand.
secret.grace: The previous key keeps working until {{when}}. Update your ERP before then, or complete the rotation once it uses this key.
secret.noGrace: The previous key no longer works.

guide.title: How your ERP calls the API
guide.note: Share this with the developers who connect your ERP.
guide.keyHeaderBody: The ERP ingestion key, in this header on every request. Keep it on your server, never in a browser or a shared file.
guide.idempotencyBody: Required. 16 to 128 characters, letters, digits and . _ : -. Use one value per submission attempt and send the same value again when you retry it, so a retry is never taken as a second invoice.
guide.sourceBody: The document's own number in your ERP (external_document_id) and its version (external_version). Fawtir uses them to recognise a document it already has, so sending it again does not create a duplicate.
guide.supplementBody: The issue time and the transaction type (BTOM-001), which an ERP document does not carry.
guide.answersBody: 202 accepted. 200 already received. 409 a conflict with an earlier document. 422 refused, for example because the mapping is not certified. 401 the key is wrong, expired or revoked. 403 ERP is not enabled.

home.title: ERP integration
home.subtitle: How documents reach Fawtir from your ERP, worked out by the server for the period you choose.
home.noAccess: This overview needs permission to read ERP connections and invoices. Ask an administrator if you need it.
home.notEntitledBody: Fawtir has not switched ERP integration on for your organisation. Contact Fawtir to enable it.
home.automationOff: Scheduled collection is paused across Fawtir right now, so managed connections will not collect until it resumes.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.note: Counts for the period, worked out by the server. Open a label to see the documents.

checklist.title: Setup
checklist.note: Worked out from what the server holds now. Nothing here is remembered by this browser.
checklist.windowNote: A step that counts documents looks at the period chosen above.

runs.noneFailed: No failed runs in this period.

access.title: Access and history
access.subtitle: What your role can do in ERP integration, and the record of changes made to it.

yours.title: Your access
yours.note: From the permissions the server gave your session. Only an administrator can change them.

personas.title: Typical roles
personas.note: Fawtir has no ready-made role for these. An administrator builds a role from the permissions listed.

tenantAdministrator.name: Tenant administrator
tenantAdministrator.body: Everything, including API keys, the change history and who has access.

integrationAdministrator.name: Integration administrator
integrationAdministrator.body: Sets up connections, sign-in details and the mapping, and certifies it.

integrationOperator.name: Integration operator
integrationOperator.body: Watches connections and documents and checks a connection when something looks wrong.

invoiceSubmitter.name: Invoice submitter
invoiceSubmitter.body: Uploads documents and follows what became of them.

reportingViewer.name: Auditor or reporting viewer
reportingViewer.body: Reads connections, documents and runs. Cannot change anything. The change history needs an administrator.

history.title: Change history
history.note: The ERP history from the server, limited by the server to ERP connections, documents, enablement and mappings.
history.needsPermission: Your role can't see the ERP history. Ask your administrator to give it access to ERP audit records.

apiErrors.forbidden: Your account doesn't have permission to do this. Ask an administrator in your company if you need it.
apiErrors.notFound: We couldn't find this record. It may have been removed, or the link may be wrong.
apiErrors.conflict: Someone changed this while you were working on it. Reload to see the latest version, then try again.
apiErrors.csrf: Your session needs refreshing. Reload the page and try again.

refused.generic: The server refused this. Nothing was changed, and repeating it will not help — the reference below tells support exactly which rule stopped it.
refused.creditNoteSupplierMismatch: This credit note is from a different supplier than that bill. A credit can only reduce a bill from the supplier who issued it.
refused.creditNoteCurrencyMismatch: The credit note and the bill are in different currencies, so one cannot reduce the other.
refused.creditNoteAlreadyApplied: This credit note has already been used against that bill. Applying it again would reduce the bill twice.
refused.creditNoteExceedsBill: That is more than the bill still has outstanding.
refused.creditNoteExceedsCredit: That is more than this credit note has left.
refused.creditNoteTargetNotPayable: That document is not a bill you can credit.
refused.refundAmountInvalid: A refund has to be an amount above zero.
refused.refundDateRequired: A refund has to record the day it was paid.
refused.debitNoteAlreadyDecided: That decision is already the one on record. Only the opposite decision can be recorded.
refused.debitNoteReasonRequired: A refusal has to say why.
refused.debitNoteReasonTooLong: That reason is too long. Shorten it and record the refusal again.
refused.orderTransitionInvalid: The order is not at a step where that can be done. Reload to see where it actually is.
refused.orderNotEditable: This order can no longer be edited at the step it has reached.
refused.orderConcurrentUpdate: Someone changed this order while you were working on it. Reload to see the latest version.
refused.orderLinesRequired: An order needs at least one line.
refused.overReceipt: That is more than the order still has due.
refused.receiptLinesRequired: Book in at least one line.
refused.receiptQuantityInvalid: A booked-in quantity has to be above zero.
refused.receiptDateRequired: A delivery has to record the day it arrived.

invoiceImport.guidance: Your invoice data must follow the template below. Download it, fill in your invoices, and upload it here. One row is one invoice line. Where an invoice has several lines, repeat the same reference in the first column and the rows will be grouped into a single invoice. Invoice numbers, dates and identifiers are generated by Fawtir and are not in the template. Everything you upload is created as a draft, so nothing is sent until you review and issue it. A file can hold up to {{rows}} rows and {{size}} MB; split a larger file into several.

signingIn.policy: How long a session lasts and when a one-time code is asked for are set by Fawtir for now; they cannot be changed from this screen. A one-time code by email needs nothing set up, so only authenticator apps are listed.
signingIn.count_one: {{count}} of {{total}} people has an authenticator app set up.
signingIn.count_other: {{count}} of {{total}} people have an authenticator app set up.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: The roles this company has and the permissions each one holds, as Fawtir records them.

invite.subtitle: They get an email from Fawtir with a code to join this company.
invite.defaultRoleOnly: You cannot list this company's roles, so the invitation gives the default role.
invite.noRoleMeansDefault: Choose none and the invitation gives the default role.

reportReal.subtitle: Last complete quarter: {{from}} to {{to}}

signupResume.description: Enter the email you registered with. If a registration with it is waiting to be finished, we'll send a 6-digit code there.
signupResume.codeSent: If a registration with {{contact}} is waiting to be finished, we've sent it a 6-digit code. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
signupResume.invalid: That code is incorrect or no longer valid. Check your latest email, or request a new code.
signupResume.codeSent_one: If a registration with {{contact}} is waiting to be finished, we've sent it a 6-digit code. It expires in 1 minute.
signupResume.codeSent_other: If a registration with {{contact}} is waiting to be finished, we've sent it a 6-digit code. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.

subscription.title: Subscription

notice.notTracked: Fawtir manages this subscription for you. Contact Fawtir about renewal or changes.
notice.trialEnding_one: Your free trial ends on {{date}}. {{count}} day left.
notice.trialEnding_other: Your free trial ends on {{date}}. {{count}} days left.
notice.grace: Your paid period ended on {{ended}}. Invoicing and tax reporting keep working until {{until}}.
notice.paymentRequiredBilling: Payment is due. Your issued invoices, reports and exports stay available. Pay the bill below using one of the ways shown.
notice.paymentRequiredPlan: Payment is due. Your issued invoices, reports and exports stay available. Pay the bill in Settings › Bills and payment.
notice.cancelled: Your subscription ended on {{date}}. Your issued invoices and reports stay available to read and export.
notice.cancelScheduled: Your subscription ends on {{date}} and will not renew.
notice.notStartedBilling: Your subscription has not started yet. It starts when Fawtir has confirmed your payment. Your records stay available to read, download and export.
notice.notStartedPlan: Your subscription has not started yet. It starts when Fawtir has confirmed your payment; Settings › Bills and payment shows where it stands. Your records stay available to read, download and export.

subscription.scheduledChange: You move to {{plan}} on {{date}}, when your current paid period ends.
subscription.cancel: Cancel at the end of this period
subscription.actionFailed: That did not go through. Reload the page and try again.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel your subscription?
cancelConfirm.body: Your subscription stays active until {{date}}. After that it will not renew, and your issued invoices and reports stay available to read and export. Payments already made are not refunded.

subscription.blockedByPayment: A payment for your next period is being checked by Fawtir. You can change your plan or cancel once it is confirmed or rejected.

switchOff.title: What switches off at renewal
switchOff.subtitle: Choose which users and branches switch off when your plan changes at renewal.
switchOff.summaryNote: Takes effect on {{date}}, your renewal date.
switchOff.ofIncluded: {{active}} now, {{included}} included in the new plan
switchOff.noBranchLimit: {{open}} now, no limit in the new plan
switchOff.howItWorks: Nothing is deleted. From {{date}} a switched-off user can no longer sign in, and their name stays on everything they made. A switched-off branch keeps all its records. If you do not choose, the most recently added switch off first. The owner, administrators and the Head Branch always stay. You can change your choice until then.
switchOff.usersChoose_one: Choose {{count}} user to switch off on {{date}}.
switchOff.usersChoose_other: Choose {{count}} users to switch off on {{date}}.
switchOff.usersAllStay: The new plan includes everyone. All users stay active.
switchOff.branchesChoose_one: Choose {{count}} branch to switch off on {{date}}.
switchOff.branchesChoose_other: Choose {{count}} branches to switch off on {{date}}.
switchOff.branchesAllStay: The new plan includes all your open branches. They all stay open.
switchOff.branchesUnlimited: The new plan has no branch limit. All branches stay open.
switchOff.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
switchOff.notAllowed: This choice could not be saved. Someone on it may have changed, or the plan change was withdrawn. Reload the page and choose again.
switchOff.noneWaiting: No plan change is waiting for your renewal, so nothing will switch off.

billing.title: Charges and payment
billing.nothingDue: Nothing is due right now. You can prepare the bill for your next period when you are ready to pay it.

bill.notTaxInvoice: This is a statement of your subscription charge, not a tax invoice.

billing.howToPay: How would you like to pay?

BANK_TRANSFER.title: Bank transfer
BANK_TRANSFER.body: Transfer the total to the account shown, then send us the receipt.

CASH.title: Cash
CASH.body: Pay the total in cash at Fawtir's office.

CARD.title: Pay by card
CARD.body: Pay the total now on the card provider's secure page.

billing.noMethod: Payment can't be made here yet. Contact Fawtir to pay this bill.

bank.proofPick: Drop the receipt here or choose a file
bank.proofLimits: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to {{size}} KB

proofRejected.size: That file is too large. Choose a smaller one.
proofRejected.type: Choose a PDF, PNG or JPEG file.

cash.instructions: Pay the total in cash at Fawtir's office. Your bill stays open until Fawtir has confirmed the cash payment.

BANK_TRANSFER.SUBMITTED: Pending verification by Fawtir. We have your transfer receipt; the bill is paid once Fawtir has checked it against our bank account.
BANK_TRANSFER.RECEIPT_RECORDED: Pending verification by Fawtir. We have your transfer receipt and are checking it.
BANK_TRANSFER.AWAITING_SECOND_APPROVAL: Pending verification by Fawtir. Your transfer has been checked and is waiting for a second approval.

CASH.SUBMITTED: Your cash payment is with Fawtir and is being confirmed. The bill is paid once it is confirmed. Please do not pay again.
CASH.RECEIPT_RECORDED: Fawtir has recorded your cash payment and is checking it.
CASH.AWAITING_SECOND_APPROVAL: Your cash payment has been checked and is waiting for a final confirmation at Fawtir.

billing.rejected: Your last payment was not accepted: {{reason}}. You can pay again below.

refusal.bill-not-payable: This bill can't be paid now. Reload the page to see its latest status.
refusal.payment-method-unavailable: That way of paying isn't available right now. Choose another or contact Fawtir.
refusal.payment-state-conflict: This payment is already being checked, so it can't be changed. Reload the page.
refusal.billing-not-configured: Bills can't be prepared yet. Contact Fawtir.
refusal.subscription-not-tracked: Fawtir manages billing for your subscription directly. Contact Fawtir to pay.
refusal.idempotency-key-reused: Reload the page and try again.
refusal.other: That did not go through. Reload the page and try again.
refusal.bill-stale: Your plan changed, so that bill was replaced. Pay the current bill below.

billing.bankUnavailable: Bank transfer is temporarily unavailable because proof can't be stored safely right now. Try again in a few minutes.
billing.bankNoAccount: Bank transfer is temporarily unavailable because Fawtir has not configured a verified bank account.

card.instructions: You will enter your card on the card provider's secure page, not in Fawtir. The bill is paid once the provider has confirmed the payment to Fawtir.
card.redirecting: Taking you to the secure card page…
card.uncertain: We couldn't confirm whether your card payment was started. Check again before paying another way: checking never charges you twice.
card.notStarted: The card payment was not completed. Check your payment status before trying again.
card.notForThisBill: This bill can't be paid by card. Please use bank transfer or cash.
card.notRepresentable: This bill can't be paid by card. Please use bank transfer or cash. Bill total:
card.underReviewBill: A card payment for this bill is being reviewed. Please don't pay again; Fawtir will contact you.
card.switchedOff: Card payment isn't available right now. Please use bank transfer or cash.
card.contactMissing: Add your company's contact person, e-mail and phone before paying by card.
card.untrustedPage: The card payment page could not be opened safely. Nothing was charged. Contact Fawtir.
card.statusUnreachable: We couldn't check your card payment just now. We'll keep trying.

status.PROCESSING: Pending confirmation from the card provider. This usually takes a moment.
status.NOT_COMPLETED: The card payment was not completed. Check your payment status before trying again.
status.UNDER_REVIEW: We received a card payment we need to check. Fawtir will contact you; please don't pay again.
status.REVERSED: This card payment was refunded. Fawtir will contact you about this bill.

signupWaiting.BANK_TRANSFER: Your transfer is being checked. Fawtir has the bank transfer receipt you sent when you signed up, and your subscription starts once Fawtir has confirmed it. Please do not pay again.
signupWaiting.CASH: Your cash payment is with Fawtir and is being confirmed. Your subscription starts once it is confirmed. Please do not pay again.
signupWaiting.CARD: Your card payment from sign-up is with Fawtir. Your subscription starts once Fawtir has confirmed it. Please do not pay again.

billing.signupConfirmed: Your payment from sign-up is confirmed. Your subscription starts when Fawtir activates your company.

billDue.title: Your subscription bill is ready
billDue.activation: Pay it to activate your subscription. Your plan becomes active once the Fawtir team confirms the payment.

companyInvitation.title: Join your company on Fawtir
companyInvitation.description: Choose the username and password you will sign in with. The address this invitation was sent to stays your sign-in email.

done.title: Your account is ready
done.body: Sign in with your new username and password. Your administrator chose your role when they invited you.

missing.title: This link is incomplete
missing.body: Open the invitation link from your email again. For your security the link is read once and then removed from the address bar.

spent.title: This invitation can’t be used
spent.body: The link is invalid, has expired, or was already used. Ask your company’s administrator to send a new invitation.

reason.suspended: Your subscription is read-only until the renewal is paid.
reason.trialEnded: Your free trial has ended. Your subscription is read-only until you pay.
reason.cancelled: Your subscription has ended and is read-only until you renew it.
reason.notStarted: Your subscription is read-only until your payment is confirmed.
reason.enterpriseTerms: Your subscription is read-only until the Fawtir team sets your Enterprise terms.

subscriptionReadOnly.askToPay: An administrator of your company can pay.

waitingDocuments.title: Supplier documents waiting
waitingDocuments.subtitle: Documents your suppliers sent that you can't open yet
waitingDocuments.reported: They have arrived, the Tax Authority has been told you received them, and your suppliers have had their reply. You can see who sent each one and when, but you can't open it or record it as a bill until the reason below is put right. They open oldest first.
waitingDocuments.noneBody: Every supplier document you have received is in your bills.

explain.NO_DOCUMENTS_LEFT: Your documents for this month are used up. These open as soon as extra documents are added, or when your allowance resets.
explain.SUBSCRIPTION_ENDED: Your subscription has ended or is waiting for payment. These open as soon as it is paid.
explain.COMPANY_NOT_ACTIVE: Your company is not active on Fawtir yet. These open once Fawtir activates it.

banner.body: They have arrived and been reported to the Tax Authority, but can't be opened yet.

near.title: You have used {{percent}}% of this period's documents.
near.body: {{used}} of {{allowance}} used, issued and received together: supplier documents you receive count too. When none are left, issuing stops and received documents are held until extra documents are bought.

full.title: You have used all of this period's documents.
full.body: {{used}} of {{allowance}} used. Issuing has stopped, and the supplier documents you receive are held until extra documents are bought. They open as soon as extras are added.

extraDocuments.title: Buy extra documents
extraDocuments.subtitle: Documents bought ahead, on top of your plan's monthly allowance, for this subscription month.

month.title: This month's allowance
month.none: None left. You can't issue documents until you add extra documents or the allowance resets, and supplier documents you receive are held.
month.held_one: {{documents}} supplier document is waiting. Held documents open first, oldest first, when extra documents are added.
month.held_other: {{documents}} supplier documents are waiting. Held documents open first, oldest first, when extra documents are added.
month.expiry: Extra documents are used after your plan's own documents and end on {{date}}, with them. Unused ones are not carried over or refunded.

buy.title: Choose how many
buy.note: Priced by Fawtir at your plan's rate per document.
buy.howAdded: Ordering issues a bill to pay. By card the documents are added at once; by bank transfer or cash, once Fawtir confirms the payment.

quote.expires: Added to this subscription month. They end on {{date}}.
quote.upgrade: This month's extra documents would cost more than moving up to the {{plan}} plan. Contact Fawtir to move to a bigger plan.

order.title: Your order
order.note_one: {{documents}} extra document, added once the payment is confirmed.
order.note_other: {{documents}} extra documents, added once the payment is confirmed.
order.replaces: Ordering a different number replaces the order you have not paid yet.

result.added_one: Paid. {{documents}} extra document is added to this month, and held supplier documents open first.
result.added_other: Paid. {{documents}} extra documents are added to this month, and held supplier documents open first.

extraDocuments.notOffered: Your plan has no extra documents to buy. Contact Fawtir about your allowance.
extraDocuments.noPermission: Only people who manage the plan can buy extra documents.

history.title: Extra documents
history.note: Bought by your company or added by Fawtir. Unused extra documents are never refunded.

refusal.extra-documents-not-offered: Your plan has no extra documents to buy. Contact Fawtir.
refusal.billing-not-configured: Extra documents can't be billed yet. Contact Fawtir.
refusal.subscription-not-tracked: Fawtir manages billing for your subscription directly. Contact Fawtir to add documents.
refusal.subscription-state-conflict: Extra documents can be bought while your subscription is active. Pay your subscription first.
refusal.payment-state-conflict: A payment for extra documents is already being checked. Wait for it before ordering more.

fawtirDisconnection.dangerZoneNote: Only the owner and Administrators see this.
fawtirDisconnection.title: Disconnect from Fawtir
fawtirDisconnection.intro: Stop using Fawtir as your e-invoicing service provider on the Fawtara Portal. This is separate from cancelling your subscription: cancelling never disconnects you.
fawtirDisconnection.toldNote: The owner and administrators are e-mailed when the status changes.
fawtirDisconnection.onYourBehalfCall: Fawtir support started this on your behalf after your call.
fawtirDisconnection.onYourBehalfEmail: Fawtir support started this on your behalf after your e-mail.
fawtirDisconnection.fromNotice: Recorded by Fawtir support from a Tax Authority notice.

line.removalReceived: Received on {{date}}. We'll complete your removal within 1 business day.
line.askReceived: Received on {{date}}. Fawtir will raise a disconnection request on the Fawtara Portal for you to approve there.
line.approveByDate: Approve Fawtir's request on the Fawtara Portal by {{date}}. If you don't, it is cancelled after 3 days.
line.notCompleted: Your request was not completed, so you're still connected to Fawtir.
line.notDisconnectedOnPortal: The Fawtara Portal still shows Fawtir as your service provider, so you're still connected to Fawtir.
line.withdrawn: Withdrawn. You're still connected to Fawtir.

after.subscription: Your subscription stays until {{date}}, then ends without renewing. The remaining days are not refunded.
after.nothingSent: Nothing is sent or received through Fawtir any more.
after.records: Every record stays readable and exportable for the legal retention period.

step.PORTAL_REQUEST_RAISED: Fawtir raised the request on the Fawtara Portal
step.PORTAL_DISCONNECTION_CONFIRMED: Disconnection confirmed on the Fawtara Portal
step.PORTAL_NOT_DISCONNECTED: Still connected on the Fawtara Portal
step.PORTAL_REQUEST_WITHDRAWN: Fawtir withdrew the request on the Fawtara Portal

ALREADY_DISCONNECTED.title: Yes, I've already disconnected. Remove me from Fawtir.
ALREADY_DISCONNECTED.body: You have already ended Fawtir's connection on the Fawtara Portal.

ASK_FAWTIR.title: No. Ask Fawtir to disconnect me.
ASK_FAWTIR.body: Fawtir raises a disconnection request on the Fawtara Portal and you approve it there.

MOVING_TO_ANOTHER_PROVIDER.title: I'm moving to another service provider.
MOVING_TO_ANOTHER_PROVIDER.body: You are connecting to a different provider on the Fawtara Portal.

dialog.title: Disconnect from Fawtir?
dialog.question: Have you already disconnected from Fawtir on the Fawtara Portal?
dialog.movingNote: Nothing is needed in Fawtir. Connecting to your new provider on the Fawtara Portal is enough: a company uses one provider at a time, so Fawtir is told and removes you from the Oman SMP within 1 day.

path.ALREADY_DISCONNECTED: Fawtir checks the disconnection on the Fawtara Portal and removes you from the Oman SMP within 1 business day.
path.ASK_FAWTIR: Fawtir raises a disconnection request on the Fawtara Portal. Approve it there within 3 days; if you reject it or don't answer, it is cancelled and you stay connected.

warning.nothingSent: After disconnection, nothing is sent or received through Fawtir.
warning.legalDuty: Issuing e-invoices is your own legal duty, so have another service provider ready.
warning.records: Every record stays readable and exportable for the legal retention period.
warning.subscription: Your subscription runs to the end of the period already paid, then ends without renewing. The remaining days are not refunded.
warning.withdraw: You can withdraw the request until it completes.

error.nameMismatch: That is not this company's name. Type it exactly as shown.
error.notOwner: Only the company's owner or an Administrator can do this.
error.impersonating: This can't be done while Fawtir support is signed in as your company.
error.changed: The request changed meanwhile. The latest status is shown.
error.failed: That didn't go through. Try again.
